extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.37.0: for Skyline 0.29.0's YouTube-style Live TV overlay: its On now and Coming up rows, previous / next channel, and the card showing which channel those buttons go to.
0.36.0: Live TV (Skyline 0.28.0): the guide's Restart row holds up to 24 programmes, so every channel's fits; the TV page has room for six guide groups, so the Match day row still shows with Premier Sports and Freeview.
0.35.1: Kodi restarts and updates no longer wait 30 s on this add-on: its service stops within Kodi's 5 s (waiting timers are cancelled).
0.35.0: Live TV (Skyline 0.27.0): OK shows what's on with the playback buttons; Left/Right open the recent channels with the one watched before selected (OK watches it); the TV page's Recent channels includes the channel you're watching; the guide's Restart row stays full around the hour (a programme stays to its end; just after it, the one that just ended).
0.34.0: TV page (Skyline 0.26.0): live and upcoming matches carry Sky's LIVE / UPCOMING tags, upcoming ones show just the time; Remove from recent channels on the TV page works again.
0.33.1: Live TV: a long OK while browsing channels (even after Back hid the banner) opens the TV guide instead of playing the browsed channel; after Back, OK opens the recent channels.
0.33.0: tidy-up for Skyline 0.25.0: the Live TV quick guide's code is gone (the TV guide replaces it); one less background task.
